written: before any device arm ran in this row; the replay refuses to start if this file is absent
why_zero: this row changes no model code, ships no lever and alters no default. It measures what the fold's own shapes can do.
clock: 1350 MHz requested through ARC FORCE_AICLK on card 0 and sampled at ~1 kHz DURING every timed loop by a separate process. An interval that is not min == max == 1350 with no read error and no gap above 10 ms is an artifact and is dropped.

cube8192_TFLOPs.basis: four independent Blackhole dense-cube measurements cluster at 104.93 to 114.20 TFLOP/s. Outside the allowed range the instrument or the clock is wrong, not the chip.

cube8192_start_vs_end_pct.basis: the same cube measured at both ends of one session bounds session drift. Above 2 % the session is not a single measurement.

dram_add8192_GBs.basis: a starved 8192x8192 add over 402,653,184 bytes admits no reuse, so its rate is the DRAM roof. p300c's published class is several hundred GB/s; a reading above 900 would exceed the physical bus.

matmul_class_ceiling_TFLOPs.basis: roof_pair_transition measured 28 % of cube on one unit's own shapes and triangle multiplication came in 5.89x off its own session's cube (17 %). The fold's largest matmul key is out=[1,512,768] K=768: a 24x24-tile output over 110 cores is about 5 tiles per core, so it is launch- and traffic-shaped rather than cube-shaped. I predict 20 to 45 % of the measured cube.

matmul_class_fold_seconds_floor.basis: 131.269 TFLOP of recorded linear+matmul FLOPs divided by the predicted ceiling. This is a LOWER bound on the class's fold seconds because every arm keeps its faster configuration.

three_byte_classes_fold_seconds_floor.basis: the two contaminated in-house roofs bracket multiply_ + layer_norm + add_ at 2.074 to 2.523 s. I expect the measured floor inside that bracket or below it, because both roofs were taken at an unknown clock.

decision_rule.question: does the matmul class have rate headroom at the fold's real shapes, or is the modelled 19.88 TFLOP/s already the shape ceiling?
decision_rule.headroom_real_if: measured class ceiling >= 2x the modelled 19.88 TFLOP/s, i.e. >= 39.8 TFLOP/s. Then the fold is leaving rate on the table at shapes it already runs and Phase 2 has a kernel target.
decision_rule.target_does_not_exist_if: measured class ceiling <= 1.25x 19.88, i.e. <= 24.9 TFLOP/s. Then the fold is already at what these shapes can do, the frontier's 8.9 to 9.1 s of matmul headroom is not reachable without changing the shapes themselves, and the campaign should say 10.0 s does not exist on this fixture.
decision_rule.between: report the measured ceiling and the implied reachable saving, and name what fraction of the 4.846 s requirement it covers. No verdict is invented to fill the gap.

refutation: The known-answer control must return exactly 1,099,511,627,776 FLOPs and exactly 402,653,184 bytes for 8192^3. Anything else: STOP, no table row is written.
Any arm whose measured rate exceeds the same-session cube is an instrument error and its row is refused, not reported as a finding.
Any arm whose weighted fold seconds alone exceed the 14.881 s bare fold median is an arithmetic error and the table is refused.
A cube measured outside the allowed range, or a start/end cube disagreement above 2 %, invalidates every rate in the session.
A foreign holder on card 0 at any point, or containment/srcversion not matching A10759A24565BC5BBE903C5, invalidates the session.
not_claimed: This row does not measure the fold's in-situ per-op time; a standalone replay of a shape is an upper bound on its rate and therefore a lower bound on its fold cost.
No whole-fold CLOSURE is claimed from this measurement alone.
No accuracy, parity, default or production change.
